title: Support case-insensitive comparison in the diff editor (diffEditor.ignoreCase)
description: Add a `diffEditor.ignoreCase` setting so the diff editor can treat text that differs only in letter case as unchanged — analogous to the existing `diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace`. I work on data-warehouse migration projects where I regularly diff two revisions of the same SQL script set. SQL keywords are case-insensitive, and different developers and formatting tools emit them differently (`SELECT` vs `select`, `FROM` vs `from`). title: Support explicit `[\`symbolName\`](path/to/file.py)` symbol links and deprecate optimistic backtick matching
description: The chat response renderer currently supports "optimistic" symbol linkification: when the model outputs `` `symbolName` ``, the Copilot extension searches the workspace for a symbol with that name and—if found—emits a `ChatResponseAnchorPart` that renders as a pill widget. This approach is prone to false positives (linking to wrong files, unrelated variables, etc.) which degrades user trust in the links feature.
